founder_explicit.persistent_activation: check overlapping active preferences first; unresolved potential/direct conflict blocks activation
founder_explicit.scope_rule: use the narrowest scope supported by the Founder statement

founder_approved.source: a candidate or proposed rule explicitly approved by the Founder
founder_approved.persistent_activation: activate only after provenance and overlapping scope are checked
founder_approved.supersession: preserve prior history; replacement must identify superseded rule

repeated_observation.source: repeated behavior or outcome signal without explicit approval

conflict_resolutions.label: KEEP OLD
conflict_resolutions.effect: retain the active rule and preserve the new instruction as unresolved or candidate evidence

conflict_resolutions.label: OVERRIDE
conflict_resolutions.effect: supersede the old rule without deleting its history

conflict_resolutions.label: SCOPE SPLIT
conflict_resolutions.effect: replace an overlapping broad rule with the supplied non-overlapping scoped rules

conflict_resolutions.label: ONE-OFF EXCEPTION
conflict_resolutions.effect: apply to one named generation and do not carry into later generations

mechanical_boundary: The store records scopes, provenance, resolution, snapshots, and rollback; the LLM identifies semantic conflicts.
